name: Four Seasons Resort Seychelles
positioning: Hillside beach resort with tree-house villas above Petite Anse bay on Mahé, the main island of the Seychelles
best_for: Couples who want a private villa with its own pool
Beach travelers who want a secluded bay on Mahé

facts.text: The resort has 67 rooms in total.
The resort is in a secluded private bay on Mahe, the main island of the Seychelles.
The resort is nestled into a lush hillside leading down to a white-sand beach.
Every villa has its own infinity pool.
The resort's design is local Creole style with extensive use of wood and stone.
Le Syel Spa has 8 treatment rooms.
Le Syel Spa is located at the uppermost point of the resort, with sweeping Indian Ocean views.
Koi is the resort's Japanese restaurant.
Steak Shack serves premium grilled meat, seafood and vegetables.
Il Forno is an Italian restaurant located directly on the beach.
The fitness center is 128 sq m.

highlights.text: The Hilltop Ocean-View Villa has a wraparound plunge pool that looks onto the bay.
Serenity Villas are one-bedroom villas designed with romance in mind.
In the Two-Bedroom Ocean-View Suite, each bedroom is housed within its own pavilion.
A Floating Breakfast in the Pool is served on a floating tray in your villa's plunge pool.
The Miracle of Coco De Mer is a five step spa ritual that includes a bath overlooking the bay.

considerations.text: Seychelles International Airport is 18 km from the resort.
Golf, helicopter tours and deep sea fishing are off-site activities.
WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires connecting flights.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
